notes.title: 05/27 (Tue) Update Details [Updated on 06/05 07:10 (UTC)]
notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]
 
‘King Arthur: Legends Rise Update 🔥
Everything you need to know about the new content and events will be available below.
 
Check below for more details!
 
 
[h1]👑 05/27 (Tue) Update Details[/h1]
 
 
[b]■ New Content[/b]
(1) Event Arena
A new arena has been added to the Colosseum! In the Event Arena, you can enjoy fierce battles with various buffs and seasonal heroes.
 
For a period of 2 weeks, you will be able to challenge the ‘King Arthur’s Legendary 200’, chosen based on the Arena tier from the previous week.
 
Starting from the no. 200, a list of 4 players is displayed, and you can challenge them using Arena Tickets. If you win, Honor Tokens will be distributed based on your opponent’s rank.
Defeating a high-ranked player in one go will also earn you the rewards for the rank below.

 
① Season Buff
- Core buffs applied during the Season.

② Enhanced Heroes
- Heroes who will receive exclusive stats increase buffs if included in the Event Arena team.

③ Enhancement Buffs (Purchasable)
- Available on a daily basis, these buffs can be purchased, and are maintained until the end of the season.
- 5 common buffs + 1 special buff will be available daily, and you can choose 4 of them to purchase.
- Purchased buffs are cumulative, and special buffs are skill-based and disappear when you win the battle.
 
* Clear Main Story [Normal Mode 5-7] to be able to enter the Event Arena.
* Arena Tickets are recharged daily at 00:00 (UTC) to the max. amount one can own.
                                                 	
 
(2)  Equipment Engraving System
A new ‘Equipment Engraving’ system will be added, allowing additional stats to be granted to equipment. It is now possible to enhance your equipment even further!
 
- You can add 2 types of stats: basic and special stats.
- When engraving, both stats and values change at the same time according to set rates, and it is not possible to change only one of them.
- Materials required to engrave can be obtained by dismantling equipment.
 
* The stats and values vary based on the equipment part.
* Clear Main Story [Normal 4-7] to use Equipment Engraving.
 

(3) Dismantle Equipment System
A ‘Dismantle Equipment’ system will be added. The materials required to engrave equipment can be obtained through this system.
 
You can obtain 3 engraving materials and gold at set rates.
 
- Forged Fragment: basic engraving material
- Transformed Residue: material consumed when engraving ‘basic stats’
- Recovered Essence: material consumed when engraving ‘special stats’

* Clear Main Story [Normal 4-7] to use Equipment Dismantling.
 

(4) Hall of Conquerors Season 2
New bosses will appear in the Hall of Conquerors.
 
- Blazing Gorgos: a boss that receives additional damage from Inflict DOT and DOT Explosion effects.
- Ciaran: inflict debuffs on Ciaran to increase the damage dealt by your allies.
- Talos: the existing Talos element will change to Storm.

 * [Hall of Conquerors] Season Ranking Rewards have been updated, changing Caliburn Arhur ‘Frost Relic Shards’ for ‘Storm Relic Shards’. [b][Added on 06/05 07:10 (UTC)][/b]
* [Hall of Conquerors] Season Ranking Rewards will change periodically. [b][Added on 06/05 07:10 (UTC)][/b]

[b]■ New Additions[/b]
- [Clan] New feature to send clan invitations via chat to promote the clan and encourage member recruitment.
- [Clan War] New option to include members who have not been in the clan for at least 24h to be eligible to participate in the war in the War Request conditions  (The member will be displayed in the member’s list).
- [Clan War] New War Team preset settings.
- [Inventory] New function to bulk open probability/chance based chests.
- [UI] New ‘Auto Challenge Next Stage’ will be added to stage breakthrough-type content.
 
 
[b]■ New Events[/b]
-  New   Legendary   Hero  ‘ Hild ’  Rate Up Summon.
* New heroes will only be available through the Rate Up Summon. It will not be possible to obtain Charlotte through other Summon Tickets (Legendary Hero Summon Selection Ticket, Legendary Hero Summon Ticket, Rare - Legendary Summon Ticket, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.
* New Relics will only be available through the Rate Up Summon. It will not be possible to obtain the newly released Relics through other Summons (Relic Summons, Relic Summon Tickets, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.
- 0.5-Year Anniversary Event 1
- 0.5-Year Anniversary Event 2
- Stamina Consumption Event
- Arena Challenge Event
- Event Arena Daily Missions Event
- Raid Bounty:  Tarrasque
- New/Returning Player Check-in Event

[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/52/508][b]🔗 Check out the [Event Notice][/b][/url]
 
 
[b]■ New Packages[/b]
- 30 New Packages
- 3 New Packages exclusive for New Players.
- 3 New Packages exclusive for Returning Players.
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/47/3295][b]🔗 Check out the [New Packages Notice][/b][/url]
 
 
[b]■ Improvements[/b]
 
(1) Mission Rewards Improvements
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/fa9605a40237f93dd31b2a45fbbdad211267c403.png[/img]

 
(2) Power Up Dungeon
- [Equipment Dungeon] Removes 4★ equipment from Floor 10 on each Equipment Dungeon, and increases the appearance rates of 5-6★ equipment.
- [Power Up Dungeon] Reduces the difficulty of Floors 7 to 9 of each dungeon. (Excluding Burning Land)
- [Power Up Dungeon] Adds Gorgos Passive Skill
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/6e3694782d73efcb00943e94e2d082b7faf6ca4a.png[/img]
* The information above considers the Boss info values in Burning Land 7.
 
(3) Forbidden Dgn Hard Ach. Pack
- Adjusts the achievement conditions from Floor 60 to Floor 50, and Floor 50 to Floor 45.
 
(4) Event / Special Shops
- Unifies how the rarity of items is displayed in their name. (The rarity will be displayed before the item’s name without brackets)
- Adds colors to the name of items available for purchase to improve the visualization of the rarity.
- Probability-based items of Rare - Legendary grade will use the prefix ‘Mysterious’ and colors will be applied to represent their grades.
- Improves how rarity is displayed for icons of Statue items.
- Improves the Special Shop tab menu so it won’t disappear even if you scroll down/up.
 
(4) Other Improvements
- [Tutorial] Simplified the paths of some tutorials.
- [Favor Dungeon] Improves the dungeon, allowing all Favor Dungeons to be open at all times.
- [Main Story] Changes element of the star achievement condition from opposite element to normal element.

- [Account] Increases the max. amount of Stamina for each account level.
- When leveling up, the maximum amount of Stamina will be granted.
 

[b]■ Bug Fixes[/b]
 
[Hero]
- Issue where the buff icon was not displayed when Gawain gained the ‘Guardian of May’ buff during battle.
- Issue where if a monster dies while Tristan still has an extra turn left, it is not possible to proceed with the battle.
- Issue where Baudwin’s ‘Share Damage’ was not applied correctly.

- Adjusts the size of texts for some buttons in English so that they fit the button.
- Issue where events were not displayed again if you close the mini banner in the Lobby screen.
- Issue where the buff description of enemies with long names would go over the info pop-up limits.
- Issue when selecting certain options in the Equipment filter, both the filter option and the equipment filter pop-ups would close.
 
[Other Bug Fixes]
- [Battle] Issue where occasionally the Harpies on Podarge’s Sanctuary would not be displayed.
- [Battle] Issue where after using a skill, closing the game while in battle, and reconnecting the game, the battle time would freeze, reducing clear time.
- [Clan] Issue when accepting a Clan invitation, the button would not be deactivated immediately.
- [Clan War] Issue where the War Schedule was displayed incorrectly in the season registration pop-up window.
- [Hall of Conquerors] Issue where the regular attack damage font was displayed even when a critical hit was triggered when attacking the Steel-flanked Penveid.
- [Clan Raid] Issue where the UI of the Restricted Area’s ticket information would disappear after the Raid’s ranking pop-up.
- [Shop] Issue where the selection icon was not displayed in the image and purchase pop-up of certain selection chests on sale.
- [Item] Issue when using selection chests, the order of the ‘owned’ and ‘max’ amount was displayed incorrectly.
- [Mail] Issue when the Inventory was full and there were items in the Mail to be claimed, the ‘No mail to Read & Claim All’message would be displayed.
- [Test Skills Mode] Issue where the game would crash when trying to use the ‘Skill Order Settings’.

[b]■ New Content[/b]
(1) Hall of Conquerors
A new content, ‘Hall of Conquerors’, has been added to the Restricted Area.
It consists of 3 dungeons, and the dungeon composition changes every Season.
 
You can earn various rewards, including ‘Memory Rudiment’, and their distribution depends on the highest damage record achieved within a limited number of turns.
Compete with other players for the best record of the season and earn additional rewards based on your position.
 
[b]* The ‘Hall of Conquerors’ will open on 04/30 (Wed) 00:00 (UTC). You must clear Main Story [Hard Mode 3-7] to unlock this content.[/b]
* Each hero has a specific ‘Memory Rudiment’, and you can summon that hero once a certain amount of the new item.
* Daily Missions and Achievements related to the Hall of Conquerors will be added to the game.
 
[b][url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/50/2969]🔗 Check out the [[CM Tips] Hall of Conquerors][/url][/b]
 
(2) New Hero Power Up Content ‘Level Breakthrough’
A new system has been added to allow the expansion of a Hero’s Max Level.
 
The Breakthrough Level increases based on each Tier of the Chivalry Oaths, 1 Level per Tier. In total, the Max Level of a Hero can be expanded up to Lv.70 (considering Chivalry Tier 10).
 
Once you level up a hero to Lv.60, a ‘Breakthrough’ button will replace the ‘Power Up’ button in the Hero Management screen.
The criteria to Breakthrough will be displayed in the Power Up screen of heroes that can go through breakthrough.
 
[b]* Clear Main Story [Hard Mode 5-7] to be able to use Breakthrough.[/b]
* Royal Road ‘Path of Transcendence’ will be added for breakthrough level achievements.
 
(3) Special Summon ‘Wishlist’ System
Select 4 heroes, and once reach a guaranteed summon you will have a chance of 1/4 to summon one of them.
Once you add heroes to your Wishlist, the remaining Legendary heroes not included in it will not be summoned in regular or guaranteed summons.
 
If you don’t add any heroes to it, the current rules for the Special Summon will be applied when summoning.

- x20 Reward: Legendary Talisman Selection Chest x5
- x45 Reward: Legendary Tome Selection Chest x5
- x70 Reward: Legendary Talisman Selection Chest x10
- x100 Reward: Legendary Tome Selection Chest x10

‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ Update 🔥
From Legendary Hero’s Rate Up Summon all the way to new events, everything you need to know about the update is available below! 💨
 
Check below for more details!
 
 
[h1]👑 03/18 (Tue) Update Details[/h1]
 
 
[b]■ New Additions[/b]
- [Chat] New features: 1:1 Chat during battle and pin Chat
- [Forge] When crafting Keepsakes, add a Hero List to show which heroes can equip that keepsake.
- Weekly/Monthly Packages renewal.
 
 
[b]■ New Events[/b]
ⓛ Legendary Heroes ‘‘Aine’ & ‘Claudas’ Rate Up Summon
② Aine Mission Event
③ Claudas Mission Event
④ Stamina Consumption Event
⑤ Clan Activities Event
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/52/508][b]🔗 Check out the [Event Notice][/b][/url]

[b]- Special Summon’s Legendary Hero List Update[/b]
- Adds the Legendary Hero ‘Ceres’ to the list of heroes in the Special Summon banner.

The summon rates applied will vary based on the rates at the time you use the item.
 

[b]- Clan War Improvements[/b]
① The Lord and Clan Senate can make requests to occupy specific Footholds using the [1:1 Request] button during the War Preparation period.
② The [Clan] icon effect of the Estate will change based on the Clan War period.
③ A Team deployment function will be added so that in the event heroes are not deployed to a Foothold, a temporary Team will be automatically deployed instead.
④ Improves the acquisition of win/defeat points based on the Clan War Tier grade.
⑤ Adjusts the period of events related to the Clan War, so that the event starts at the same time as Clan-related content resets.
⑥ General convenience improvements.
 

[b]- Rate Up Heroes ‘Aine’ & ‘Claudas’ Balance Adjustments[/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/bcaaad878bb8c43037a501b9f2d2b9332db72f5a.png[/img]

notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]
 
‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ update is here! 🔥
Everything you need to know about the new content and events will be available below.
 
Check below for more details!
 

[h1]👑 02/18 (Tue) Update Details[/h1]
 
[b]■ ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ Web Shop Opening[/b]
The official Web Shop for ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ is about to open!

For more details, make sure to check out the notice below.
We hope you enjoy the new shopping experience!
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/47/2268][b]🔗 [‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ Web Shop Opening Notice][/b][/url]
[url=https://kingarthur-shop.netmarble.com][b]🔗 [‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ Web Shop Link][/b][/url]
 

[b]■ New Content[/b]

(1) Equipment Dungeon: Podarge's Sanctuary
A new Equipment Dungeon, ‘Podarge's Sanctuary’, has been released!
 
You can obtain Equipment with Prevention, Safeguard, or Ascension Set Effects in this dungeon.
Include heroes with [AoE] attacks and [Inflict DOT] in your team and take on this new challenge!
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/47/2258][b]🔗 [3 New Equipment Set Notice][/b][/url]
 
(2) Profile Portrait System
The Portrait System is a new feature that will be added to make the journey in the game even more special for everyone.
 
You can select and set up ‘Frames’ by going to [My Account] > [Profile] screen.
Frames can be earned by clearing the respective and meeting the requirement(s).
 
Those who achieve Ranks 1 to 10 in Clan War, Arena, and Forbidden Dungeon will receive frames. After this first release, new ones will be released regularly in the future!

When you select a Frame, it will be applied to your Hero’s icon and visible to other players.
 
 
(3) Higher Arena Grades
New grades will be added to the Arena for our players who have been enjoying the Colosseum battles. Above the current Master I grade, Challenger and Champion grades will be available!
 
Challenger/Champion grades will select the top 100 players (in order of high score) who reach 7,500 points or more in Master I.  
If a player is not included in the top 100, they will stay in Master I, and players who have reached 7,500 or more will be demoted to Master 1’s starting score when the season resets.

Grade Achievement Rewards and Season Rewards will be distributed upon reaching Challenger and Champion grades, and more details on the rewards are available in the game.
 
In the event more than one player achieves the same amount of points, the player who reached that rank faster will be ranked higher.

However, in the event that a player’s current score drops to match another player's score, the player whose score dropped will be ranked higher.
 
[b][Challenger/Champion Grades Organization][/b]
· 1st:  Champion Gold  
· 2nd - 3rd: Champion Silver
· 4th -10th:  Champion Bronze  
· 11th -100th:  Challenger  
 

[b]■ New Events[/b]
ⓛ New Legendary Hero ‘Charlotte’ Rate Up Summon
* New heroes will only be available through the Rate Up Summon. It will not be possible to obtain Charlotte through other Summon Tickets (Legendary Hero Summon Selection Ticket, Legendary Hero Summon Ticket, Rare - Legendary Summon Ticket, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.
* New Relics will only be available through the Rate Up Summon. It will not be possible to obtain the newly released Relics through other Summons (Relic Summons, Relic Summon Tickets, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.
② Charlotte Event Dungeon
④ Stamina Consumption Event
⑤ Clan Activities Event
⑥ Podarge's Sanctuary Clear Event
⑦ Raid Bounty: Gorgos Event
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/52/508][b]🔗 Check out the [Event Notice][/b][/url]
 

[b]■ Improvements[/b]

- Notification System Improvements
Currently, notifications on Heroes and Relics other players have summoned or enhanced are displayed in the global chat, causing inconvenience to many of our players.
To reduce this inconvenience, a new feature will be added, allowing you to turn notifications ON/OFF.
 
You can turn notifications ON/OFF for Hero and Relic Acquisition, as well as Clan-related notifications through the [Game Settings] → [Notifications] menu.
 
- New Lucky Chest Exchange System
As a player’s Combat Power increases, a lot of power up resources obtained while playing end up unused. Taking that into consideration, a system for exchanging unused resources into [Lucky Chests] will be added to alleviate the inconvenience some of our players experienced trying to dispose of any excess items.
 
Use your excess resources to craft the chests in the [Mages' Tower] → [Alchemy] → [Daily Perks] tab.
In order to use this feature, you must reach ‘Mages' Tower’ Lv.3.
 
- Special Shop Integration
Improvements will be made to integrate the various shops that have been operating separately under the ‘Shop’ since the launch of ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’
into one [Content Shop], providing one central access point for all content-related shops.
 
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/09146db07265486bbf74a2ed0f461003acdfa712.png[/img]

[b][Content Shop Organization][/b]
· Arena Shop
· Forbidden Dungeon Shop
· Market , Forge
· Clan Shop
 
To prevent any misunderstandings, the existing [Shop] will be renamed to [Package Shop]
 
- Special Summon’s Legendary Hero List Update
- Adds the Legendary Hero ‘Vivian’ to the list of heroes in the Special Summon banner.
 
* After the 02/18 (Tue) Update is complete, ‘Vivian’ and ‘Vivian Relics’ can be obtained through Special Summon, Relic Summons (Flame, Frost, Storm), Legendary Hero Summon Tickets (Summon Selection Ticket), Mysterious Hero Summon Ticket, Legendary Relic Shard Summon Ticket (Summon Selection Ticket), Precious Relic Shard Summon Ticket, and Mysterious Relic Shard Summon Ticket. The summon rates applied will vary based on the rates at the time you use the item.

- Adds Steam Game Recording Timeline Function
The function will be added in order to allow timeline events while in a Steam Game Recording.
 
- Skill Order Settings Improvements
Following our player’s suggestions, improvements will be made to the Skill Order Settings.
 
A button to set up the skill order will be added to the right side of the battle preparation screen when all heroes are selected.
Long-pressing the skill icon in the Skill Order Settings pop-up will display the skill information.
  
The [Skill Order Settings] button will also be added to the Arena battle preparation screen and Clan War Defense/Attack Team formation screens.
  
A new feature has been added to the Defense/Attack Team unit assignment screen
to allow setting up the skill order, and improvements were made to allow setting up the skill order separately to Defense and Attack Teams in Clan War and Arena.
 
- [Hero Management] Menu Improvements
① Improves the display and positioning of the Memory Stone count on the left side of the Hero Management screen.
② Improves the text color of the [Detailed Stat Info].
③ Displays an effect when the criteria to pledge [Chivalry] is met.

① Improves the display of resources, allowing 5 types to be displayed at the top of the main game screen.
② When making a Prioritize Defense (Defense Ping) request in [Clan War], a confirmation pop-up has been added to cases where you cancel the request through the [Cancel Request] button.
③ Improves the [Achievements], allowing navigation to other achievement categories directly from the reward claiming screen.
④ Improves the reward visualization after using the Repeat Battle feature, allowing you to check the items you receive from it.
⑤ Adds tags to Clementine, Ralph, Ardoin, Leppaludy, and Turin.
⑥ Improves the Vigor gauge reduction in Arena battles (Before: 10 seconds → After: 30 seconds).
⑦ Adds a ‘Claim All’  function to Estate building rewards.
* The 'Claim All' button (icon) will be displayed once there are resources to claim at the bottom-center of the Castle screen.
⑧ Improves the readability of effects applied due to Chivalry.
